candidates.hook: "Why does my 2 year old wake up crying every night?" What to do at 3am so nights get quieter.
candidates.angle: Problem -> fix per NHS sleep problems in young children: at night be as boring as possible, lights off; if they get up, take them back to bed with little interaction; same calm routine at the same time every night; wind down about 30 minutes before; limit settling time (one story); comfort toy; no screens 30-60 minutes before bed; ask your health visitor/pediatrician if it continues. candidates.title: Still wets the bed at 7: common, not their fault, and what helps
candidates.summary_tr: NHS: yatak ıslatma yaygın, genelde ailede görülür ve çoğu çocuk zamanla geçer. Kaçınılacaklar: cezalandırmak (durumu kötüleştirebilir), kafeinli içecekler, geceleri düzenli olarak kucaklayıp tuvalete götürmek. Ev önlemleri işe yaramazsa ya da 6 aydan uzun kuru kaldıktan sonra yeniden başladıysa doktora (GP) git.

candidates.hook: "Why does my 7 year old still wet the bed?" What's common, what helps, and when to see the doctor.
candidates.angle: Problem -> fix per NHS Bedwetting: common and often runs in families, most children grow out of it; enough drinks during the day, toilet regularly and before bed, waterproof mattress cover, reward good toilet habits (not dry nights); avoid punishing, caffeine drinks, and lifting them to the toilet at night; see a doctor if home steps don't help or if wetting starts again after 6+ months dry.
